notes: לֹא and כֹּל are fused into the single none under rule 35's negative-plus-quantifier sentence, headed on the negative and discontinuous under rule 25.

The partitive מִן keeps the of written for it, as rule 19's מִן־הַבָּשָׂר → any of the flesh reads such a preposition; the competing reading gives that of to the rectum as the chain's own relation under rule 19's first sentence, and was set aside because the מִן would then be left unrendered while a word stood in its slot.
הִפִּיל takes did let … fall, headed on the lexical verb (rule 44); the directive he takes the written to as its own unit (rule 32).
